action.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT dept_id, SUM(debit - credit) AS actual FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND period = '2026-04' AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE type = 'Expense' AND account_id >= '6000' AND account_id < '7000') GROUP BY dept_id), b AS (SELECT dept_id, SUM(amount) AS budget FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND period = '2026-04' AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE type = 'Expense' AND account_id >= '6000' AND account_id < '7000') GROUP BY dept_id) SELECT COALESCE(a.dept_id, b.dept_id) AS dept_id FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.dept_id = b.dept_id WHERE COALESCE(a.actual, 0) > COALESCE(b.budget, 0) ORDER BY 1
